hints.title: Subarray Partition Structure
hints.text: The problem asks for the minimum cost partition of the array prefix by prefix.

hints.title: Trimmed Length Tracking
hints.text: For a candidate subarray nums[j:i], maintain frequency counts. When an element count reaches 2, trimmed length increases by 2; for each subsequent repetition, it increases by 1.

hints.title: Optimal Subproblem Recurrence
hints.text: Transition dp[i] = min over j of (dp[j] + k + trimmed_length) for all j from 0 to i - 1.

hints.title: Array Splitting Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Quadratic state transitions where each subarray trimmed count is accumulated incrementally.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory stores 1D prefix cost table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that running backwards from i to 0 allows computing trimmed values incrementally in O(1) per step.
